characters.description: A highly capable lone hunter and poison alchemist travelling between Beast Lord dungeons. Jake relies on archery, close combat, heightened perception, and abilities connected to the Malefic Viper.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: The Beast Lord of the Lucenti Plains and the target of Jake's second dungeon. It commands the local herd and remains at the central pond with three unusually powerful white does.
characters.name: Great White Stag

characters.description: A man shaped by memories of the harm he has caused, including killing his brother Hermann. He intends to turn the tutorial into the foundation of his power.
characters.name: William

characters.description: An Augur of Hope who teaches and encourages the surviving camp. He completes a leadership quest, spreads Holy Church teachings, and gains knowledge connected to the Holy Pantheon.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: A named member of the surviving camp who provides combat theory for the training that Jacob offers to people without combat experience.
characters.name: Bertram

characters.description: A Holy Church priestess who receives Jacob after his one-use revival outside the tutorial and Bertram after Jacob restores him. She is the daughter of the church Grandmaster overseeing their preparation and training.
characters.name: Inara

characters.description: The deity served by Jacob's Holy Church. She accepts the preserved souls of Jacob's followers under his existing agreement and stands behind the religious path now being prepared for him.
characters.name: Holy Mother

characters.description: A level-81 ratman that commands the reservoir mole-rat swarm through the Swarm Control Rod. Jake kills the controller and destroys the rod, eliminating the remaining swarm.
characters.name: Ratman Swarm Controller

characters.description: An armored, sword-wielding ratman that guards the final incubator in the Forgotten Sewers. It uses dark mana and a domain that suppresses the senses of Jake.
characters.name: Nest Watcher

characters.description: The divine patron and ally of Jake. He intervenes when another god attempts to claim the body of William, treats Jake as a friend, and provides information about Jacob, Bertram, and Casper.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: After Jake kills William, this unidentified white-haired god removes the body. The Malefic Viper allows him to keep it only in exchange for a favor.
characters.name: White-haired god

characters.description: The god who claimed William's corpse now identifies himself as one of twelve primordials. He restores William to life and invites him to become a disciple.
characters.name: White-haired primordial

characters.description: The gold-tusked Beast Lord of the Valley of Tusks. It commands a horde of roughly one hundred Steel Tusk Boars.
characters.name: Horde Leader

characters.description: Jake and Caleb's father, remembered during Jake's dream of the family's last breakfast together before the system arrived. His present location and condition remain unknown.
characters.name: Robert

characters.description: Jake and Caleb's mother, remembered during the family's last visit before the system arrived. Jake had promised to return for her birthday, and her present fate remains unknown.
characters.name: Deborah

characters.description: Jake's younger brother. He lives near their parents and is married to Maya, who is expecting their first child when Jake last sees the family before entering the tutorial.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: Caleb's wife and Jake's sister-in-law. She is seven months pregnant with the couple's first child during Jake's last remembered family visit before the system's arrival.
characters.name: Maya

characters.description: The tree-like final ruler of the tutorial and master of the four Beast Lords. Vastly stronger than Jake, the King offers him a safe departure or a fight to the death.
characters.name: King of the Forest

characters.description: A fire-and-archery god who sponsored the tutorial and offers Jake post-tutorial training and a blessing. Jake receives the invitation alongside one from the Malefic Viper.
characters.name: Umbra

characters.description: A godly alchemist and disciple of the Malefic Viper who begins instructing Jake in alchemy within the Viper's time-dilated realm.
characters.name: Duskleaf

characters.description: A former coworker who returns to Earth among the undead. He carries a blessing respected and feared by the undead, but rejects leadership of their force.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: The unnamed risen human who leads the undead forces returning to Earth. Casper refuses a leadership role, leaving her in command while his purpose remains separate.
characters.name: Risen-human leader

characters.description: A survivor who blames Jake for Joanna's death and attacks him after the return to Earth. Jake crushes his hand during the confrontation, then leaves him a healing potion.
characters.name: Mike

characters.description: A level-61 beast attempting to control the Pylon of Civilization in the forest. Jake kills it before claiming the pylon.
characters.name: Savage Mole Lord

characters.description: A powerful archer helping Jacob recruit and protect survivors outside a sealed city. She follows his group while appearing to pursue a separate purpose connected to a god.
characters.name: Maria

characters.description: A family friend travelling with Hank, Mark, and Louise through the transformed forest. Her social skills help her negotiate temporary refuge with the masked protector of a secluded valley.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: An axe fighter with a builder profession and the father of Mark and Louise. He loses an arm protecting his children from an Oakwood Tiger before Jake rescues the group and provides a potion that restores it.
characters.name: Hank

characters.description: Hank's nineteen-year-old son and the rescued group's healer. He survives the altered forest with his father, sister, and Miranda before the party receives shelter in Jake's valley.
characters.name: Mark

characters.description: Hank's twenty-two-year-old daughter and an evolved caster. She is one of four survivors rescued from an Oakwood Tiger and allowed to recover in Jake's valley.
characters.name: Louise

characters.description: An aggressive level-89 insectoid that appears to rule the underground biodome. It is a swift flier, but Jake defeats it after it fails to adjust its tactics.
characters.name: Alpha Mantis Scyther

characters.description: The unnamed D-grade fungal network that controls the underground biodome. It is the cavern's true ruler, and Jake cannot defeat it when it awakens.
characters.name: Biodome fungal network

characters.description: A level-90 wind-manipulating hawk that encounters Jake during his early flight practice. It corrects his wing movements and balance, accepts a stamina potion, and voluntarily returns to continue teaching him.
characters.name: Level-90 hawk
